  "summary": "This pull request adds a suite of block validation unit tests along with a reusable test fixture and assertions. The new tests verify consensus failure modes across block header, stateless, contextual, and stateful validation rules. Mutations are exercised across multiple validation entry points, specifically TestBlockValidity, ProcessNewBlock, and ConnectBlock.",
  "problem": "Block validation logic is exercised across multiple entry points with differing checks and requirements, but test coverage targeting specific consensus failure modes and exact reject states at the unit level is limited. As demonstrated during review of efforts to modularize validation (such as PR #32317), subtle validation regressions can slip past existing functional and unit tests.",
